svg.title: Original Organic1-6 line-bond and all-lone-pair candidates
svg.desc: Each row has three original candidates with identical bonds and different nonbonding valence-electron dots. Row a chloroform: A has three lone pairs on each Cl; B omits them; C adds an invalid carbon pair. Row b hydrogen sulfide: A has one sulfur pair, B two, C none. Row c methylamine: A has two nitrogen pairs, B none, C one. Row d methyllithium in the explicitly stated polar-covalent model: A has three C–H bonds and one C–Li bond with no valence lone pairs; B wrongly adds a carbon pair without removing C–Li; C wrongly adds three lithium pairs. Core electrons are omitted. Connectivity drawings are not calibrated molecular geometries.

g.text: Original line-bond choices · every dot is one VALENCE electron
Connectivity and electron bookkeeping only; no calibrated bond angles or real aggregate structure implied.
Ionic limiting notation instead: Li⁺[CH₃:]⁻ · one C lone pair replaces, rather than supplements, C–Li.
